snippet.title: Microsoft Flight Simulator | City Update 16: Italy
snippet.description:
Available today! Widely celebrated as one of the most historically important countries for its contributions to art, culture, science, and modern civilization, Italy comprises some of the world’s most beautiful and noteworthy cities. Microsoft Flight Simulator City Update 16 highlights nine urban areas throughout Italy, ranging from the country’s north to its southern tip, including the islands of Sardinia and Sicily. The areas covered include coastal cities, inland metropolitan regions, and urban areas set to dramatic natural backdrops. 

Microsoft Flight Simulator City Update 16: Italy is available to all owners of Microsoft Flight Simulator (2020) and Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 today for FREE. Ensure that you have the latest simulator version installed, download City Update 16, and explore the incredible sights of these beautiful locations throughout Italy! The sky is calling!
